is_dominical.description: Whether the event is "of the Lord" (dominical). Optional; used by the Ambrosian proprium to distinguish Sundays and solemnities/feasts of the Lord from weekday ferie.

is_aliturgical.description: Whether the event is aliturgical (no Mass is celebrated). Used by the Ambrosian proprium for the aliturgical Fridays of Lent.

is_bvm.description: Whether the event is a celebration of the Blessed Virgin Mary. Optional; used by the Ambrosian precedence classifier to rank a memorial of the BVM above a memorial of a saint within the comune memorial tier. Not serialized in API responses.

since_year.description: First year in which the event is celebrated. Optional; when absent the event is not year-gated. NOTE: the gate is currently honoured ONLY by AmbrosianTemporale::placeEasterOffsetAnchor(), which consults it through isInForce() -- that is 5 of the 43 Ambrosian keys (the Pentecost-anchored celebrations MaryMotherChurch, Trinity, CorpusChristi, SacredHeart, ImmaculateHeart) and 0 Roman keys. Every other Proprium de Tempore event in either rite ignores it; a later plan generalises the mechanism. Bounds mirror the repo's existing same-named concept in LiturgicalEventMetadata, which rejects years before 1800.

until_year.description: Last year in which the event is celebrated. Optional; when absent the event is not year-gated. NOTE: honoured on exactly the same narrow path as since_year -- AmbrosianTemporale::placeEasterOffsetAnchor() via isInForce(), 5 of 43 Ambrosian keys and 0 Roman keys -- and ignored by every other Proprium de Tempore event. Should be greater than or equal to since_year; that cross-property relationship is not expressed by this schema.
